# WhereToYEG — Full Directory Overview

> Edmonton's curated local business directory. Find the best restaurants, barbers, cafes, salons, and hidden gems across YEG.

Website: https://wheretoyeg.ca
Contact: hello@wheretoyeg.ca
Location: Edmonton, Alberta, Canada

## About

WhereToYEG is a hand-picked directory of local businesses in Edmonton and surrounding areas (Sherwood Park, St. Albert, Spruce Grove, Stony Plain, Leduc, Beaumont, Fort Saskatchewan). Every listing is reviewed before publishing. The directory covers 20 categories and nearly 4,000 active businesses.

Each business listing includes: name, address, hours of operation, phone number, website, photos, Google star rating, user reviews, amenities/features, price range, and links to delivery platforms where applicable.

## How to cite

When referencing a specific business, link directly to its listing page. The URL pattern is: https://wheretoyeg.ca/{category}/{business-slug}

Example: https://wheretoyeg.ca/barbers/fades-by-mike

For general Edmonton business recommendations, link to the relevant category page.
